During the [[Jedi Civil War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched a campaign '''advancing''' through [[Realspace/Legends|space]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vulta-bound campaign makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. An exact date is not provided for the battle, and it only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose.<ref name="EA" />
